div.head: I Cn 23
div.ab: And we lærað, þæt man wið healice synna ⁊ wið deoflice dæda scylde swyþe georne on æghwylcne timan; ⁊ bete swyþe georne be his scriftes geþeahte, se ðe þurh deofles scyfe on synna befealle.
Godlar. We lærað, þæt man wið healice synne ⁊ wið deoflice dæda scyl[d]e swiðe georne on æghwylcne timan; ⁊ bete swiðe georne be his scriftes geðeahte, se ðe ðurh deofles scyfe on synne befealle.
And we lærað, þæt man wiþ healice synna ⁊ wið deofolice dæda scylde swyðe georne on æghwylcne timan; ⁊ bete swiðe georne be his scriftes geþeahte, se þe þurh deofles scyfe on synna befealle.
Et docemus, ut a summis criminibus totis uiribus caueamus in omni tempore; et qui impulsu diaboli peccatum inciderit, propensius emendet consilio penitentię suę.

Adhuc ortamur, ut criminalia peccata et diabolica facta quisque a se arceat in omni tempore; et diligentissime emendet secundum sui confessoris . . ., quisquis per impulsum diaboli in peccatum corruit.
Godlar. We lærað þæt man wið healice synne ⁊ wið deoflice dæda scylde swiðe georne on æghwylcne timan, ⁊ bete swiðe georne be his scriftes geðeahte se ðe ðurh deofles scyfe on synne befealle.
And we lærað þæt man wið healice synna and wið deoflice dæda scylde swyþe georne on æghwylcne timan; and bete swyþe georne be his scriftes geþeahte, se ðe þurh deofles scyfe on synna befealle.

(Gute Lehre B) Und wir ermahnen, dass man vor tiefen Sünden und vor teuflischen Thaten recht ernstlich sich jeder Zeit wahre; und büsse recht ernstlich nach seines Beichtvaters Rath, wer durch Teufels Antrieb in Sünden verfällt.

(Good teaching, B) And we instruct that people guard themselves very eagerly at all times against grievous sins (sin, B) and devilish deeds; and let whoever falls into sins at the devil's prompting atone very eagerly according to his confessor's advice.

Divine Precepts. We enjoin that grievous sins and devilish deeds be very zealously guarded against at all times. He who, through the instigation of the devil, falls into sin shall very zealously make amends according to his confessor's advice.

And we instruct that people are to guard themselves most zealously against mortal sins and devilish deeds at all times; and those who fall into sin by the temptation of the devil are to repent most sincerely according to the guidance of their confessor.
div.note: B's ‘Godlar’ is a red heading. ‘befeolle’ in the Wulfstan homily 308.; Robertson (p. 139) takes I Cn from B, which begins at ‘mæssedæg’ in 14.2, the earlier clauses being supplied from G; BR: added from Gesetze I p. 305, October 2026 (MS Cons)
